findings.quote: Persistence mechanics are optional only for the management-only core install.
findings.lines: L37 (with the section heading at L35, 'Authoritative storage is mandatory for analysis')
findings.whyItFailsDR202: This sentence quantifies mandatory persistence mechanics over EVERY install that is not the management-only core. The adopted D-002 slice ('Trusted TypeScript analysis -- CLI-first, offline, contained', ADOPTED 2026-08-13, turn-3 CONSENT a15f9ac2...) ships an analysis install that is non-authoritative by construction -- local rebuildable cache/index and operational metadata only; authoritative sealed closure, replay, and evidence custody OUT; DR-106, DR-109, DR-113 deferred WHOLLY; DR-G06/G11 not slice-1-required; install is fresh signed download. Read literally, L37 makes the verified storage-mechanics component (or minimal backend) mandatory for that slice-1 install, forcing DR-106/109 subject matter into slice-1 design -- exactly what this dispatch's test 5 instructs flagging. The section's OPERATIVE obligation (L38-42) is correctly scoped to 'every supported authoritative offline analysis closure', and the heading's word 'analysis' (not 'authoritative analysis') actively supports the forcing reading, so the defect is a specification ambiguity at the mandatory-storage boundary -- a named DR-202 finding-area -- in bytes frozen before D-002 existed. An implementer reading the frozen file cannot determine whether a non-authoritative analysis install lawfully omits storage mechanics; DR-202's own bar ('specified to the depth its register rows demand') is not met while the quantifier is ambiguous over the D-002 boundary.
findings.proposedRoute: Scoping amendment by the V2 architecture editor through the register's own process, executed with (or referenced by) the D-002-mandated DR-106/109/113 deferral disposition artifacts: rescope L37 and the L35 heading so mandatory storage mechanics attach to authoritative offline analysis closures only, and a non-authoritative analysis install (slice 1) is lawful with declared DR-124 cache/metadata classes and no storage-mechanics component. This is a V2 topic-doc edit plus a D-002 scope disposition, not a V1 authority matter; it changes no register row status.
